description:
Erection of a part two, part single storey rear infill extension to the house, following relocation of the existing timber cabin outbuilding within the rear garden, and installation of
replacement first floor rear glazed doors and windows with a minor side extension to first floor rear outrigger and juliet
balcony
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1929/2/01; 19229/2/02; 1929/2/11 (Rev A); 1929/2/12 (Rev A); 1929/3/FS12; 1929/3/FS13  Received:  04 February 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the part two storey, part single storey rear infill extension hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - The existing timber cabin outbuilding located within the house's rear garden shall be re-sited within the rear garden prior to the completion of construction works for the part two storey, part single story rear infill extension hereby approved no closer than two metres to the rear of this extension's rear elevation, or be fully removed from the rear garden.
